metadata.description: posture-intake: runs when a person selects Trigger logic app on the Defender for Cloud recommendation, or when workflow automation reports the recommendation Healthy, one run at a time. It takes only the storage account and the recommendation's name from the event and reads the recommendation's status and text from Azure, re-reading for up to 10 minutes when the event reports Healthy before Azure does. Unhealthy, with no approved private endpoint yet: files one GitHub Issue with each source's evidence, asks the Foundry agent posture-remediator for the smallest Bicep fix, checks the edited file (between the posture:editable markers, only comments and storagePrivateEndpoint: true or false), opens it as a draft pull request, and starts the what-if preview. Healthy: records Defender's confirmation on the Issue.

Defender_lags_behind_the_fix.inputs: The storage account already has an approved private endpoint: Defender for Cloud has not reassessed it since the fix. Nothing to file.

Issue_body.inputs:
**Storage accounts should use private link** · RequestHub's attachment storage account in resource group `@{parameters('resourceGroupName')}`

RequestHub keeps every attachment in this account. It has no approved private endpoint, @{if(equals(coalesce(body('Get_storage_account')?['properties']?['publicNetworkAccess'], 'Enabled'), 'Disabled'), 'and its public endpoint is closed, so RequestHub cannot reach it: attachment uploads fail.', 'and its public endpoint is open, so the account is reachable from the internet and only authentication protects the attachments.')}

| Source | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Resource configuration | @{if(greater(length(body('Approved_private_endpoints')), 0), concat(string(length(body('Approved_private_endpoints'))), ' approved private endpoint ✅'), 'no private endpoint ❌')} | public network access @{coalesce(body('Get_storage_account')?['properties']?['publicNetworkAccess'], 'Enabled')}; read from Azure Resource Manager at @{formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')} UTC |
@{join(body('Policy_rows'), decodeUriComponent('%0A'))}
| Microsoft Defender for Cloud · @{body('Get_assessment')?['properties']?['displayName']} | @{body('Get_assessment')?['properties']?['status']?['code']} ❌ | @{coalesce(body('Get_assessment')?['properties']?['metadata']?['severity'], '-')} severity, status since @{formatDateTime(coalesce(body('Get_assessment')?['properties']?['status']?['statusChangeDate'], utcNow()), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')} UTC (Defender for Cloud > Recommendations) |

Azure Policy and Defender for Cloud evaluate the same built-in policy definition, *Storage accounts should use private link*, on separate schedules, so their results can differ for a while. Neither proves on its own that the configuration changed: the resource configuration does.

### Where to fix it

In this repository's Bicep for the solution, `solutions/05-secure-microsoft/infra/`, not in the portal, so the next deployment keeps the fix. The Foundry agent `posture-remediator` drafts the change as a pull request; a person reviews and merges it.

### Done when

- [ ] A pull request changes the Bicep, and its Azure what-if preview (commit status `posture/what-if`) shows only storage networking changes.
- [ ] A person reviews and merges it, then applies it with `azd provision`.
- [ ] The Azure Logic App `posture-verify` records the private endpoint in place and Azure Policy compliant on this Issue, and closes it. Defender for Cloud confirms on its own schedule.

Do not add a policy exemption, change the assignment's effect, or open the public endpoint to make the finding disappear.

Filed by the Azure Logic App `posture-intake` from the Defender for Cloud recommendation at @{formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')} UTC.
